warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 1.50 + 3.00 (4.50); y = A-B-C-D at 2.00 + 1.00 + 2.00 (5.00). Origin A1. Same main chains print on S-01 (both views), S-03 roof plan, the three truss elevations and A-06 sections A/B. Vector CAD PDF; the Thai text layer is mis-encoded, so every value was read off the rendered page.

Roof/eave edges: S-03 prints 1.00 outside grids 1 and 3 and outside rows A and D -> dummies 1' (-1.00), 3' (5.50), A' (-1.00), D' (6.00). D' is also the outer edge of the GS slab on S-01 (D + 1.00) and the 1.00 on A-06 section B — one line.

Truss elevations (S-03, second sheet) print their panel chains against the column posts: T1 (grid 1, posts at A/B/D) 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.500 | 0.833 x3, sub-totals 2.00 | 3.00; T2 (grids 2/3, posts at A/C/D) 0.833 x3 | 0.500 | 1.000 | 1.000, sub-totals 3.00 | 2.00; T3 (ridge, posts T1/T2/T2 at grids 1/2/3) 0.750 | 0.750 | 1.000 x3, sub-totals 1.50 | 3.00. Every tick became a line per section 4 rule 4 (x 1'', 2', 2''; y A'', A''', A'''', B', C', C'', C'''). The elevations carry no grid bubbles; the A end is identified by the post positions (columns A1/B1/D1 on grid 1, A2/C2/D2 on grid 2) and both trusses put the ridge 2.50 from that end, matching S-03's 0.50 | 0.50 split of B-C.

0.833 x3 = 2.499 against the printed 2.50 (T1 B'->D, T2 A->B'): inner ticks positioned off the line the chain starts from (A'' 0.833, A'''' 1.666, C' 3.333, C''' 4.166); the last segment of each group absorbs the 0.001.
Before-origin dummies share the first main line prime sequence (1' -1.00 then 1'' 0.75; A' -1.00 then A'' 0.833, A''' 1.000, A'''' 1.666).

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนนภายใน (A-01 notes + A-06). Beam tops +0.15 / +0.25 from the S-01 beam tags. T3 truss depth 0.750 below +4.11 gives an unlabelled dummy level 3.36. ระดับดินเดิม (S-04) and ระดับฝ้าเพดาน (A-06) print no value -> level_m null; the footing depth 1.00 below ระดับดินเดิม stays on the footing elements.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01, S-03 (both sheets), S-04, S-05 plus A-06 (building sections, for levels). S-04/S-05 print only member-internal dimensions (footing plan sizes 0.50+0.50 / 0.60+0.60, section sizes, slab thicknesses), which stay on their elements. The other architectural/MEP sheets (A-02 site plan, A-03 floor/roof plan, A-04/A-05 elevations, A-07, A-08, E-01, SN-01..SN-03) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run.
